CI Artifacts vs Dependency Cache

Artifacts are outputs saved or transferred between jobs; caches accelerate repeated work and are
not a release guarantee.
Artifact එක build output එකක්. Cache එක dependencies නැවත download කරන කාලය අඩු
කරනවා. Release artifact එක cache එක මත පමණක් depend කරන්න එපා.
Store dist/ as an artifact; reuse npm download cache keyed by lockfile.

Lockfile Dependency cache Build · Build dist artifact Deploy · Read the diagram: Lockfile → Dependency cache → Build; Build → dist artifact → Deploy · ඉහළ visual එJක් components සහ ඒවා අතර සම්බන්ධය බලන්න. Artifact එක build output එකක්.

# Workflow design (pseudocode)
cache: npm downloads, key=lockfile hash
artifact: dist/, release=commit SHA
deploy: exact artifact
Expected result: A cache miss may slow the build; the release artifact identifies what is shipped.
Can a cache replace a release artifact?
No. Caches may be evicted or shared; artifacts are explicit outputs.
